create_R3M_model: create an R3M model with a ResNet34 visual encoder and language reward on a given device
run_R3M_forward: run the R3M forward pass to encode image observations into feature representations
get_R3M_reward: get the language-based reward from start and end state embeddings using sentence descriptions
compute_R3M_similarity: compute the similarity between two embedding tensors using L2 distance or cosine similarity
review_R3M_init: review the R3M model initialization to understand ResNet size options and language weight configuration
